roll.9:
18 May 2023: Evan returned from a family trip to the Rockies in his new Prius; he had repaired and sold his old Prius. Shared a lake-and-mountain photo. Sam shared a sunset car photo and a childhood hiking memory with their dad at age 10. Evan paints watercolors to relieve stress and encouraged Sam to try hobbies.

24 May: Evan recalled a peaceful Jasper/Icefields Parkway trip. Sam worried about weight after a check-up; Evan suggested enjoyable exercise and small food changes. Sam planned to paint.

6 June: Evan was frightened by heart palpitations. They discussed healthier eating (less processed food and sugar), seltzer instead of soda, and exercise; Evan offered to teach Sam the basics.

27 July: Sam was hurt that friends mocked their weight and planned to go to the gym. Evan encouraged small steps, produce, fewer sugary snacks, popcorn or fruit, and recommended *The Great Gatsby*.

7–13 August: Evan said his health challenges had lasted about two years; family, a fitness watch, and hikes motivated him. He met a Canadian woman on a trip, now his significant other; they hiked and biked (shared a tent photo). Sam said Evan’s support helped amid health struggles and shared the quote “Don’t fear it, just take the first step.” They discussed perseverance and small wins. Evan often loses his keys; Sam described a flying dream.

15 August: Evan’s son injured his ankle playing soccer; he was in a cast and improving, and the injury wasn’t serious. Sam had a health wake-up call, took a cooking class, made grilled salmon and vegetables, and offered recipes. They encouraged each other.

19 August: Sam was eating healthier, shared a spinach-avocado-strawberry bowl, and felt more energetic and less sluggish after meals. Shared grilled chicken/vegetable stir-fry and homemade sauce recipe (recipe-card photo). Evan began painting classes to meet like-minded people and improve, inspired by a friend’s painting. He was learning watercolors and observing nature; shared forest and ocean-sunset paintings, plus nature/tree and truck photos. Evan recalled road trips and a drive to Banff the previous month, where he skied; hopes to return next year. He enjoys skiing, snowboarding, and ice skating and invited Sam someday. Sam wants to ski but doubts their body can handle it.

27 August: Sam said a diet and exercise routine started the previous Monday had made a huge difference and they felt great. Evan had twisted his knee on 25 August; it was painful and disrupted his fitness routine, which frustrated him. He hoped to get physical therapy and swam / kept things low-key meanwhile. Evan mentioned an unnamed book he couldn’t put down. He shared a photo of his car by a lake with mountains, from a Rocky Mountains road trip the previous month; he found the scenery refreshing and calming. Sam likes nature but hadn’t taken a road trip in ages and found hiking challenging; hoped improved health would make hiking possible. Evan suggested hiking and invited Sam to go together sometime. He shared lake-and-mountain photos of an unnamed lake with nearby trails, about a two-hour drive away. Sam said a day trip was doable and planned to check it out.
roll.17:
18 May 2023: Evan returned from a Rockies family trip in his new Prius after selling his repaired old car; shared a lake/mountain photo. Sam shared a sunset photo and childhood hiking memory. Evan paints watercolors to relieve stress.

May–October 2023: Sam worked on healthier eating, exercise, and weight loss, while dealing with cravings, work stress, family pressure, and a gastritis-related ER visit. Evan encouraged gradual progress and offered fitness advice; walking and dietary changes had helped his own well-being. Sam took a cooking class and made salmon and vegetables. Evan painted, took painting classes, hiked and skied, and had knee problems. They discussed hiking or kayaking together but did not schedule an outing. Evan has a son and a Canadian partner he met while she was traveling.

9 November 2023: Sam shared they’d become a Weight Watchers coach in their group, hoping it would help them stay motivated and help others. Evan congratulated them. Evan said he’d lost his job the previous month due to company downsizing and was looking for work; Sam offered support. Evan received a 1968 Kustom K-200A vintage guitar as a gift from a close friend. He shared a beach-sunset photo from his peaceful favorite spot near home, where he unwinds, especially during hard times. They agreed to plan a visit together the following month.

21 November 2023: Sam checked in. Evan said he’d had a health scare the previous week after doctors found something suspicious at a check-up; it turned out to be a misunderstanding, and he was fine. The scare made him value life and enjoy the present. Sam had discomfort limiting movement and found dietary changes difficult. Sam shared a photo of a book showing a man on its cover, describing it as their feel-good “flick”; the title is unknown. They agreed to make a habit of appreciating little things each day and offered each other support.

Evan said he stays fit by going to the gym and taking his car out for a spin. Sam said fitness goals were hard to reach; Evan encouraged patience and persistence. Evan shared photos of a small island with a lone boat, a sun shining through clouds over water, someone walking on a beach at sunset, and a sunset over water. He said the island was where he grew up and is his happy place, a serene spot that shaped him and remains special. Sam admired its beauty and peacefulness. Evan ended by saying Sam could talk to him anytime; Sam told him to take care.
roll.25:
18 May 2023: Evan returned from Rockies family trip in new Prius; shared lake/mountain photo. Sam shared sunset and childhood hiking memory. Evan watercolors to relieve stress.

May–Oct 2023: Sam worked on diet/exercise/weight loss amid cravings, stress, gastritis ER visit and low confidence; took cooking class, made salmon/vegetables. Evan encouraged gradual change, shared fitness tips; painted, hiked, skied; knee trouble. Hiking/kayaking discussed, not arranged. Evan has son and Canadian partner.

9 Nov: Sam became WW coach. Evan lost job in October downsizing, job hunting; Sam supportive. Friend gave Evan 1968 Kustom K-200A guitar. Beach visit planned for December. 21 Nov: checkup concern was misunderstanding; Evan shared island childhood memories/sunset photos. 5 Dec Prius broke down; yoga suggested. 9 Dec partner pregnant; family reunion planned summer 2024; “Bring it on Home” is family motto. 17 Dec son recovering from bike fall; hike planned with Sam. About 19 Dec Evan married partner; shared wedding photo 26 Dec; believes in love at first sight. Sam began runs. 31 Dec Sam hiked 29 Dec; Evan had minor Prius scrape, everyone okay.

6 Jan 2024: Family informed of marriage; February Canada honeymoon planned (skiing, food, poutine). 10 Jan Evan apologized after drunkenly urinating near roses; snowshoeing with partner. Sam planned doctor visit for diet/exercise; Evan recommended swimming/yoga/walking. Sam planned beach walks.

11 Jan 2024: Sam said health issues and weight made life difficult; no favored exercise, but car rides/countryside helped relax. Shared field/fence/dirt-road photo. Evan shared kayak photo from summer camping/kayaking at sunset, and pink-flowered park tree photo from a low period. They agreed nature and small joys are calming; Evan encouraged Sam and offered support.

rebuild.9:
Evan: family Rockies hike before May 18 2023; new Prius after repairing/selling old. Jasper road trip May 20–21 via Icefields Parkway; glaciers, lakes, mountain/forest cabin. Shared lake/book photo May 24, called it glacier photo. Watercolor hobby for years, stress relief; began classes Aug 2023, landscapes/nature, to improve and meet people. July 2023 Banff skiing and Rockies road trip; likes skiing, snowboarding, skating, hiking. Aug 2023 Canada trip with new significant other; hikes/biked/explored. Children bring joy; son hurt ankle playing soccer Aug 12, improving Aug 15. Health issues; palpitations week of May 29 prompted lifestyle changes; family motivates him. Likes ginger snaps, reads *The Great Gatsby* (July 27), later unnamed book. Knee twisted Aug 25; swimming while considering PT. Bonsai symbolizes resilience; fitness watch motivates him.

Sam: special hike with father at age 10. May 2023 considering painting; health/weight concerns, soda/candy habits. July 21 friends mocked weight; resolved to change. Cooking class, healthier diet; salmon/veg Aug 14; started diet/exercise Aug 21, felt great. Wants hikes/road trip; uncertain about skiing. Aug 27 planned day trip to unnamed lake/trails, two hours away. Evan offered workout and hiking support. Sam’s Aug 12 dream: soaring over skyscrapers.
rebuild.17:
Evan and Sam are supportive friends who regularly encourage each other. Evan enjoys watercolor painting, hiking, skiing, driving, and fitness; painting and nature help him relax and express feelings. He has children and values family. Evan has dealt with health issues, a heart palpitation in late May 2023, and knee injuries in August and October 2023; physical therapy helped. He lost his job in October 2023 and was job hunting by November. He received a 1968 Kustom K-200A guitar from a friend. His favorite beach is near home; a small island where he grew up is his happy place.

Sam has worked toward better health through diet and exercise, but faced cravings, family pressure, discomfort, and health worries. A doctor warned on 2 October 2023 that Sam’s weight posed a serious risk; Sam went to the ER on 14–15 October and was diagnosed with gastritis. Sam took cooking classes, became a Weight Watchers coach on 9 November, and enjoys journaling and creative writing. Sam and Evan discussed painting, hiking, kayaking, and visiting Evan’s beach in December. They agreed to appreciate something each day. Evan’s travels included Jasper in May, Banff and the Rockies in July, and Canada in August; he met a new partner there.
rebuild.25:
Evan: family-oriented; has children, partner/wife from Canada (married week before Dec 26, 2023; told extended family Jan 5, 2024). Partner pregnant Dec 9. Family motto “Bring it on Home,” from Banff trip. Family reunion planned summer 2024. Son injured ankle Aug 12, 2023 and fell off bike Dec 12; improving by Dec 17. Evan lost job in Oct 2023 after downsizing. New Prius broke down Dec 2023; minor mountain-road-trip accident Dec 23–24, everyone okay.

Evan enjoys watercolor, landscapes, hiking, skiing/snowboarding, kayaking, cars, gym, and family. Painting relieves stress and expresses feelings; took classes Aug 2023; painting exhibited Dec 2023. Health journey began around Oct 2021; diet/walking, gym/weights. Knee injuries Aug and Oct 2023; PT, swimming/easy exercise. Loves ginger snaps (limited to two/day Jan 2024), energy balls. Grew up on an unnamed small island, his happy place. Lost keys weekly; Sam suggested GPS tracker.

Sam has pursued healthier eating/exercise; weight and health concerns, gastritis Oct 14–15, 2023. Weight Watchers coach by Nov 9. Likes journaling, creative writing, hiking, morning runs; considered painting, kayaking, yoga, weightlifting. Sam and Evan are supportive friends, discussed hikes, painting, beach visit, and exercise. Sam’s flying-over-skyscrapers dream recurs. Sam’s family is a rock. Jan 2024: planned doctor appointment; interested in low-impact exercise; enjoys nature and car rides. Both value small steps, consistency, family, and mutual support.
